runner.session: on-demand only — a Colab session ends at 12 h at most, or when idle

wake.reason: No official Colab API can start a session.
wake.steps: Sign in to Colab as the seat account, open fleet/colab-runner.ipynb, set the runtime to an L4 (or T4) GPU, paste a fresh GitHub runner registration token into the config cell, Run all.
